result:
Patched one regression in `console.py`: `/api/pacer/<lesson_id>` still used the old exact regex and would look for `L35_P2_obs_Pacer.html`; it now derives `L35_Pacer.html` for both `L35_P2` and `L35_P2_obs`.

Review findings:
- `console.py` `_ALGEBRA2_ID_RE` and `railway/server.py` `LESSON_ID_RE` now accept both `L41_P2` and `L35_P2_obs`, while rejecting `APStats_*`, raw `3-5`, and traversal-style junk.
- `web/js/api.js` `itemsForLesson()` behaves correctly: `null`/empty become `""`; `L35_P2_obs` strips to `L35_P2`; `APStats_6-4_P1_obs` strips to `APStats_6-4_P1`; raw `3-5` intentionally passes through; greedy suffix stripping also collapses impossible double-suffixed variants back to the base lesson id.
- Railway `POST /build/{lesson_id}` and `PUT /tex/{lesson_id}/{edition}` have no remaining old-shape assumptions beyond the updated validator; downstream filename, YAML-match, and storage logic all use the route `lesson_id` transparently.
- Console title fallback for missing YAML title renders as `L35_P2_obs — (obs)`. That is understandable, if slightly bare, but not a functional bug.

GitNexus MCP impact/detect tools were unavailable in this subagent environment (handshake timeout), so this review used direct code inspection instead.
